### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=15 check=True
printf "%s\n" "$HOME"
### call 2: node=spark-1 timeout=15 check=True
set -u
user=$(id -un)
printf 'USER=%s\n' "$user"
printf 'LINGER=%s\n' "$(loginctl show-user "$user" -p Linger --value 2>/dev/null)"
### call 3: node=spark-1 timeout=60 check=False
set -eu
umask 077
directory=/home/spark/.local/share/dgx-spark-controller/recipes/g-qwen3-8b-00aa11
install -d -m 700 "$directory"
tmp=$(mktemp "$directory/.prepare-00aa11bb22.env.XXXXXX")
printf '%s' QT0xCg== | base64 -d > "$tmp"
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp" | awk '{print $1}')" = 91d6a3d55e9fea7911c537afae6607c77fa8bc0f3a76c375e104ac5a8cfa84db
chmod 600 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$directory/prepare-00aa11bb22.env"
tmp=$(mktemp "$directory/.prepare.sh.XXXXXX")
printf '%s' IyEvYmluL2Jhc2gKZWNobyBvawo= | base64 -d > "$tmp"
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp" | awk '{print $1}')" = c7eb215db98c9bdfe4950111c6bb9fcd210cc3c3d0d2e8a0875b588e30d57f70
chmod 755 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$directory/prepare.sh"
### call 4: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=False
set -eu
directory=/home/spark/.local/share/dgx-spark-controller/recipes/g-qwen3-8b-00aa11
unit=dgx-prepare-00aa11bb22.service
test -r "$directory/prepare.sh"
bash -n "$directory/prepare.sh"
test -r "$directory/prepare-00aa11bb22.env"
systemctl --user reset-failed "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemd-run --user --unit "$unit" --collect \
  --setenv=PREPARE_ENV="$directory/prepare-00aa11bb22.env" \
  /bin/bash "$directory/prepare.sh"
### call 5: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=True
set -u
status=/home/spark/.local/share/dgx-spark-controller/recipes/g-qwen3-8b-00aa11/prepare-00aa11bb22.status
active=$(systemctl --user show dgx-prepare-00aa11bb22.service -p ActiveState --value \
  2>/dev/null || printf inactive)
printf 'UNIT_ACTIVE=%s\n' "$active"
printf 'DOWNLOADED=%s\n' \
  "$(du -sb /home/spark/models/Qwen--Qwen3-8B-b968826d 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')"
if [ -r "$status" ]; then
  printf 'STATUS_B64=%s\n' "$(tail -c 16384 "$status" | base64 -w0)"
fi
### call 6: node=spark-1 timeout=60 check=False
set -u
systemctl --user stop dgx-prepare-00aa11bb22.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
container=dgxc-prepare-00aa11bb22
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
  docker container inspect "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
  docker rm --force "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  sleep 1
done
exit 1
### end
